title: Blanket
text: Blanket. Very nice warm and soft blanket.

product_metadata.title: Electric Heated Blanket Queen Size 84‘’X90‘’, Double-Sided Silky Cozy Flannel Warming Blanket with Two Separate Controllers, 4 Heating Levels & 10 Hours Auto Off, Machine Washable and Home Use, Flaxen
features: Queen Size Heated Blanket and Long Power Cord: Curl up and relax, enveloped in the cozy warmth of this 84‘’X90‘' extra large heated blanket. You will get full body comfort. 14.5 feet power cord allows you to use it in the bedroom, living room, and office as you like.

Dual Controllers to heat Double Zones: The separate controllers can control temperature on left and right side. You can choose your preferred heating levels when using with lover, providing customised warm to you.

Better Quality Double-sided Flannel: Our electric blankets are super soft, lightweight, breathable, textured and better thermal insulation. Let you not only warm, and comfortable in the cold night. Generous and elegant color is suitable for all kinds of bedding.

Keeps You Warm All Night: Four heating levels and 10 hours automatic shutdown save you the trouble of turnning on the device in the middle of the night; The heat is stable and evenly distributed, so you don't need to cover a heavy quilt; You can choose the temperature you like between 86°F and 107°F, suitable for different people need.

Machine Washable and Great Idea of Gift Giving: Just detach the controller, then put it into washing machine at a maximum of 40°C/104°F. This electric heated blanket is easy to use and control, suitable for elderly parents and also a great gift for friends during the festivals.
